test: CEL auxiliary layer vs ground mount
conclusion: The auxiliary CEL layer is not the player ground-collision layer (already known) and not a ground-mount/riding restriction: a ground mount can be used and moved over grass in maps where the aux layer is 86.6% / 95.9% blocked.
remaining: Still open: fly/no-fly (no flying mount available for testing), NPC pathing, height/render use. Aux layer is 0% blocked in sky-like maps and ~86-96% blocked in cities/homes, consistent with a flight/height or NPC layer but not proven.
limitations: Only a ground mount was available; flight could not be tested.
No cell-level tracking of the mount path was recorded; observations are qualitative.
